text: If you've watched a worse song than yours blow up, here's what they did that you didn't.
They posted it. Twenty times a day.
Lyric times your lyrics and adds perfect cuts on the beat.
That template is what lets you post that much.
Paste a YouTube link, and Lyric cuts it into clips.
Now every video comes out completely different. New footage, new style, same song.
Then Autopilot posts twenty a day for you.
